verdict.rationale: Auth0 Organizations support per-organization connections and federated login for each business customer, and the B2B page says enterprise clients can configure SSO and verify domain ownership. Just-in-time provisioning is never documented; SCIM and Google Workspace directory sync is a different provisioning model and does not count as JIT. Missing for 10: documented just-in-time user provisioning on first SSO login, in-depth docs on per-org domain verification and connection-to-org mapping, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can give each customer organization its own SSO connection with verified domains and just-in-time provisioning

citations.quote: Use Auth0 Organizations to manage multiple B2B customers in a single tenant with per-organization branding, connections, members
Configure branded, federated login flows for each business.
Give your enterprise clients the autonomous tools to instantly configure SSO, verify domain ownership, and synchronize user directories via SCIM or Google Workspace.
